634	function escapeRegex(s: string) {
635	  return s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
636	}

638	type LinkMaps = {
639	  entityToRules: Map<number, Set<number>>;
640	  ruleToEntities: Map<number, Set<number>>;
641	};
642	
643	function buildLinks(entities: Entity[], rules: Rule[]): LinkMaps {
644	  const entityToRules = new Map<number, Set<number>>();
645	  const ruleToEntities = new Map<number, Set<number>>();
646	  for (const e of entities) entityToRules.set(e.id, new Set());
647	  for (const r of rules) ruleToEntities.set(r.id, new Set());
648	
649	  const candidates = entities
650	    .filter((e) => e.name && e.name.trim().length >= 3)
651	    .map((e) => ({
652	      id: e.id,
653	      re: new RegExp(
654	        `(?:^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])${escapeRegex(e.name)}(?=[^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)`,
655	        "i",
656	      ),
657	    }));
658	
659	  for (const r of rules) {
660	    const text = `${r.title ?? ""}\n${r.content ?? ""}`;
661	    for (const c of candidates) {
662	      if (c.re.test(text)) {
663	        entityToRules.get(c.id)!.add(r.id);
664	        ruleToEntities.get(r.id)!.add(c.id);
665	      }
666	    }
667	  }
668	  return { entityToRules, ruleToEntities };
669	}

915	// Entity graph — radial SVG, sectored by type
916	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
917	type GraphNode = { id: number; name: string; type: string; x: number; y: number; r: number };
918	type GraphEdge = { a: number; b: number; kind: "explicit" | "inferred"; weight: number };
919	
920	function buildGraph(
921	  entities: Entity[],
922	  links: LinkMaps,
923	  width: number,
924	  height: number,
925	): { nodes: GraphNode[]; edges: GraphEdge[] } {
926	  if (entities.length === 0) return { nodes: [], edges: [] };
927	
928	  const groups = new Map<string, Entity[]>();
929	  for (const t of ALL_COMPONENT_TYPES) groups.set(t, []);
930	  for (const e of entities) {
931	    if (!groups.has(e.type)) groups.set(e.type, []);
932	    groups.get(e.type)!.push(e);
933	  }
934	  const filledGroups = [...groups.entries()].filter(([, arr]) => arr.length > 0);
935	
936	  const cx = width / 2;
937	  const cy = height / 2;
938	  const radius = Math.min(width, height) / 2 - 60;
939	
940	  const total = entities.length;
941	  let angleCursor = -Math.PI / 2;
942	  const placement = new Map<number, { x: number; y: number }>();
943	
944	  for (const [, arr] of filledGroups) {
945	    const arcSize = (arr.length / total) * 2 * Math.PI;
946	    const step = arcSize / arr.length;
947	    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
948	      const angle = angleCursor + step * i + step / 2;
949	      placement.set(arr[i].id, {
950	        x: cx + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
951	        y: cy + Math.sin(angle) * radius,
952	      });
953	    }
954	    angleCursor += arcSize;
955	  }
956	
957	  const nodes: GraphNode[] = entities.map((e) => {
958	    const ruleCount = links.entityToRules.get(e.id)?.size ?? 0;
959	    const r = 8 + Math.min(8, Math.log2(1 + ruleCount) * 3);
960	    const pos = placement.get(e.id)!;
961	    return { id: e.id, name: e.name, type: e.type, x: pos.x, y: pos.y, r };
962	  });
963	
964	  const edges: GraphEdge[] = [];
965	  const seen = new Set<string>();
966	  const key = (a: number, b: number) => (a < b ? `${a}:${b}` : `${b}:${a}`);
967	
968	  const nameIndex = new Map<string, number>();
969	  for (const e of entities) nameIndex.set(e.name.toLowerCase(), e.id);
970	
971	  for (const e of entities) {
972	    if (!e.relatedTo) continue;
973	    const refs = e.relatedTo.split(/[,;\n]/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
974	    for (const ref of refs) {
975	      const targetId = nameIndex.get(ref.toLowerCase());
976	      if (!targetId || targetId === e.id) continue;
977	      const k = key(e.id, targetId);
978	      if (seen.has(k)) continue;
979	      seen.add(k);
980	      edges.push({ a: e.id, b: targetId, kind: "explicit", weight: 1 });
981	    }
982	  }
983	
984	  const coCount = new Map<string, number>();
985	  for (const ruleEntities of links.ruleToEntities.values()) {
986	    const arr = [...ruleEntities];
987	    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
988	      for (let j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {
989	        const k = key(arr[i], arr[j]);
990	        coCount.set(k, (coCount.get(k) ?? 0) + 1);
991	      }
992	    }
993	  }
994	  for (const [k, count] of coCount.entries()) {
995	    if (count < 2) continue;
996	    if (seen.has(k)) continue;
997	    seen.add(k);
998	    const [a, b] = k.split(":").map(Number);
999	    edges.push({ a, b, kind: "inferred", weight: count });
1000	  }
1001	
1002	  return { nodes, edges };
1003	}
